US noncitizen voting arrests: 160 cases, experts say rare

US administration efforts to identify and prosecute noncitizens voting in federal elections have resulted in 160 arrests. Experts consulted by the Associated Press suggest that instances of noncitizens voting are rare. The arrests were made as part of the administration's focus on this issue.
